name: Wibble World Giddy: Wibble Mania!
storyline:
It was a bright and inevitably enough sunny day in Clicheland.
Giddy thought he’d go out for a nice stroll.
He had just left his house when…Crump!!!
Everything went all weird.
The world began to spin around him and lights flashed before his eyes.

“Should have give the Diamond Whites a miss!” He muttered.

But no, reality was folding in on itself…this was no illusion.

“But of course! I must have entered a time space interface.”
He thought. And he had.

Suddenly the chaos stopped and he found himself in a strange forest.

“Blimey!” He gasped.
“This would make a great plot for a computer game if it wasn’t go corny!”

Checking his bearings on the morning sun, he made off on his quest home.
summary: A Dizzy-inspired game for the Amiga.
